packages.name: EthOS AntiVirus
packages.description: ClamAV-powered on-demand antivirus scanner with a native EthOS window. Read-only scans of /home, /mnt and /media; signatures update automatically.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; package service bound to loopback and reached through an authenticated proxy. 1.0.1: clearer first-start status and longer scan timeout.

packages.name: EthOS Welcome
packages.description: A tiny static welcome page for your NAS, served by nginx on port 8090.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.1: Package Center icon. 1.0.0: initial release: static welcome page with a live clock.

packages.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
packages.description: A tiny two-player tic-tac-toe game that opens directly in an EthOS window. No container, no port.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; no nginx container and no port. 1.0.0: initial nginx version.
